packages.name: himosoft-common
packages.title: Shared Himosoft library
packages.description: Interactive prompt helpers used by other himosoft-* packages. Installed automatically as a dependency.

packages.name: himosoft-k3s-server
packages.title: Interactive K3s server setup
packages.description: Prompts for public IP, domain, and optional K3s version. Installs K3s with Traefik disabled.

packages.name: himosoft-server-deps
packages.title: Server dependencies
packages.description: Installs common CLI tools (kubectl, helm, jq, etc.) with operator confirmation.

packages.name: himosoft-firewall
packages.title: UFW firewall setup
packages.description: Interactive UFW rules for Server A — prompts for admin IP and optional replica IP.

packages.name: himosoft-system-tune
packages.title: Kernel sysctl tuning
packages.description: Shows proposed sysctl values and applies them only after confirmation.

packages.name: himosoft-docker-host
packages.title: Docker host setup
packages.description: Installs Docker Engine and prompts for the user to add to the docker group.

packages.name: himosoft-server-b-replica
packages.title: Server B database replicas
packages.description: Interactive Docker Compose stack for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis replicas.

packages.name: himosoft-monitor-host
packages.title: Monitoring stack (Server C)
packages.description: Prometheus, Grafana, Traefik, and GitHub OAuth — all settings entered at the prompt.

packages.name: himosoft-node-exporter
packages.title: Node exporter
packages.description: Installs prometheus-node-exporter — prompts for listen address and port.

packages.name: himosoft-kubeconfig
packages.title: Kubeconfig export
packages.description: Exports K3s kubeconfig with your chosen server address — no automatic IP detection.

packages.name: himosoft-backup-agent
packages.title: Restic backup agent
packages.description: Interactive Restic backup — prompts for repository, password, paths, and cron schedule.

packages.name: himosoft-healthcheck
packages.title: Server healthcheck
packages.description: Read-only status report for K3s, Docker, firewall, and node-exporter. No configuration needed.

packages.name: himosoft-server-status
packages.title: Live server dashboard
packages.description: Live htop-style dashboard — CPU, memory, swap, disk I/O, TLS expiry, K3s alerts, JSON snapshot. Press q to quit.
